parameters.name: ConsumerGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the consumer group. You can call the [DescribeConsumerChannel](~~264169~~) operation to query the consumer group ID.

parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the instance ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the DTS change tracking instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
